projects.title: My Canvass
body: Spanning 700 square meters across two levels, this five-bedroom, five-bathroom home stands as a living testament to perseverance, sacrifice, and love.

For as long as I can remember, my mother’s dream was simple yet profound — to build a home from the ground up. Growing up, she poured her energy into giving us the essentials: shelter, education, and nourishment. Through years of hard work, relentless saving, and smart investing — and countless days spent working overseas — she turned that lifelong dream into reality.

The concept for this home was inspired by her vision of “our own private hotel” — a space that feels luxurious yet grounded, elegant yet easy to maintain. The design embraces a “less is more” philosophy: clean lines, open spaces, and warm natural materials like wood, glass, laminates, and stone. Every surface was chosen not only for beauty but also for practicality, keeping comfort and longevity in mind as she gracefully ages into the home she built with her own hands and heart.

More than just a project, this home is deeply personal — a symbol of gratitude, resilience, and the kind of love that endures. It’s a work in progress that continues to evolve alongside my journey as a designer, and as a son.

projects.title: Bachelor’s Pad in the Sky
body: Perched high above the city on the 41st floor of Rockwell’s iconic Proscenium, this 120-sqm residence redefines the modern bachelor’s pad. Designed for a young professional whose success is built on grit, passion, and relentless drive, this space is a reflection of achievement — a sanctuary in the sky.

Originally a two-bedroom layout, the unit was reimagined to suit the client’s evolving lifestyle during the pandemic. The transformation introduced a dedicated home office — a satellite space for business — seamlessly integrated into a one-bedroom configuration that balances function and finesse.

The design direction embraces a modern rustic-industrial aesthetic: a fusion of raw textures, warm tones, and refined finishes that mirror both strength and sophistication. Every detail was considered to create a home that feels grounded yet elevated — a true testament to modern success and personal style.

projects.title: Pastry Corner Express
projects.tagline: A 30-sqm café designed for quick sips and seamless flow.
body: Tucked inside B Hotel, Quezon City, this compact coffee spot serves as an extension of the hotel’s Pastry Corner, catering to guests and locals on the move. With its industrial charm and smart layout, the design maximizes every square meter — creating a space that feels warm, efficient, and effortlessly stylish.
A little nook that proves good design always fits, no matter the size.

projects.title: Modern Industrial Loft
projects.tagline: A 55-sqm one-bedroom loft that redefines light, modern living.
body: Following the success of my first loft project, this second commission — located just three doors down — presented a new challenge: to reinterpret my signature industrial style with a lighter, more contemporary touch.

Designed as an Airbnb investment unit, the space needed to impress guests while reflecting the personality of its owners — a Chinese family who envisioned the loft as both a stylish retreat and a gallery for their father’s photography. The result is a clean, modern take on industrial design: open, bright, and inviting, yet grounded by subtle raw textures and thoughtful detailing.
This project captures balance — between function and emotion, ruggedness and refinement, familiarity and freshness.

projects.title: Office Conversion
projects.tagline: A 291-sqm adaptive space reimagined for comfort and care.
body: As families evolve, so do their priorities. Originally designed as an office, this space was thoughtfully converted into an elderly-friendly home for the client’s mother. Its ground-floor location made it the perfect candidate for transformation — combining accessibility, safety, and modern functionality.
A project that highlights how design adapts to life’s changing seasons.

projects.title: Bachelor’s Pad
body: Tucked in the heart of Mandaluyong’s CBD, this 55-sqm studio loft belongs to a young IT professional based in Singapore. The design direction? Masculine, worldly, and unapologetically raw.

Weathered finishes, vintage accents, and travel-sourced collectibles tell the story of a well-traveled soul. Cement walls, burnt brick, weathered wood, and black metal come together to create an industrial palette that feels both rugged and refined.

Personal touches elevate the space — from a world map mural done in collaboration with the owner’s uncle, to custom furniture handcrafted by the client himself using reclaimed pallets and old caster wheels. Each piece, a testament to craft, creativity, and character.
The result is a loft that celebrates contrasts — old and new, raw and refined, personal and timeless. A statement space that doesn’t just speak of design, but of stories well-lived.
press: This loft type condo is the industrial home of your dreams

projects.title: Village Amenities
body: This project pushed me in all the right ways. I’ve always been rooted in residential design, so stepping into a clubhouse with soaring ceilings and walls of glass was both exciting and intimidating. The shell itself demanded creativity — it wasn’t just about making it look good, but making it work.

I approached it the way I always do: multiple minds, one vision. We blended modern and Scandinavian sensibilities to bring warmth, function, and personality into the vast space. The floating ceiling mounted on the trusses became the hero — solving both lighting and shading issues while serving as a defining design feature.

From there, everything fell into rhythm. Wood-finished beams, stone-wrapped counters, and lounge-style furniture softened the architecture and brought a casual, nature-inspired feel. Once the lobby came together, the rest of the clubhouse followed effortlessly.
What started as one of my most challenging projects turned into one of the most fulfilling - proof that stepping out of your comfort zone can lead to something truly remarkable.

projects.title: Dimsum Dimsum
projects.tagline: A 72-sqm commercial space brought to life with style and spontaneity.
body: Sometimes, the best projects come when you least expect them. This one was referred to me by a fellow judge from an event we both joined — proof that opportunities can truly come from anywhere.

The clients wanted to expand their dim sum business and elevate their store’s look, blending modern and industrial design with a touch of their brand identity as accent. The result? A bold yet balanced space that feels both polished and authentic — perfectly capturing their brand’s energy and flavor.
A spontaneous collaboration turned stylish success.

projects.title: Studio Mancave
projects.tagline: A 26-sqm studio unit transformed into a modern-day mancave.
body: For many young professionals, success isn’t just measured in milestones — it’s reflected in the spaces they create for themselves. This project, nestled within The Viceroy McKinley in Bonifacio Global City, embodies that dream: a studio that merges work, life, and style in one compact yet powerful statement.

Designed amid the pandemic, the layout adapts to the client’s evolving lifestyle — a space where he can both live and conduct business with ease. The design blends modern, rustic, and industrial influences, creating a masculine yet refined atmosphere that feels both grounded and aspirational.
A true bachelor’s haven in the sky — where grit meets sophistication.

projects.title: Ayala Alabang Renovation
projects.tagline: Breathing new life into a timeless masterpiece.
body: It’s always both an honor and a challenge to take on a project originally designed by an iconic architect. This home—older than I am—now finds itself in my hands, ready to be reimagined for the world we live in today. A delicate balance of preservation and reinvention, this project pays homage to its legacy while ushering in a new era of design.

projects.title: Barkhaus
body: A reception wrapped in terrazzo over a fluted-wood base, arched display niches lit by globe pendants, and grooming stations set behind framed glass — the space drawn in this site’s opening sequence.
Images are renders from the design model.

projects.title: Luxury Condominium Amenities
body: Still rising amid one of Metro Manila’s most dynamic business districts, this upcoming development is set to be the first of its kind — a bold statement of modern luxury and urban sophistication.

Designed to captivate the Class A and up market, every element of this project has been carefully envisioned to impress even the most discerning eye. From premium finishes to thoughtfully curated fixtures, the design celebrates refined taste and quiet opulence — a true benchmark of contemporary elegance in city living.

Currently in its construction phase, this condominium stands as one of the projects I am most proud to have been part of from the conceptual stage. It’s a creation that reflects both ambition and artistry — a project that promises to make its mark once completed.
The countdown continues — tick tock, tick tock.

projects.title: Glow-Up Loft in the Sky
body: Modern glam — a 55-sqm one-bedroom loft unit.

projects.title: Industrial Filipino Fusion
projects.tagline: A 90-sqm, two-bedroom unit designed to celebrate both identity and artistry.
body: This project was particularly close to my heart — a chance to design for a couple from my own LGBTQIA+ community and bring their contrasting styles into perfect harmony. One leaned toward the raw character of industrial design, while the other was deeply rooted in the “Love Local” movement. The challenge? To make both worlds coexist seamlessly without one outshining the other.

Born during the pandemic, the layout evolved to include a dedicated home office — a safe and stylish workspace for the couple’s new normal. The result is a modern interpretation of Industrial-Filipino Fusion, where metal and concrete meet rattan and native textures, and where every piece reflects a balance of individuality, purpose, and pride.

projects.title: Luxury One-Bedroom
body: Part of the Modern Luxury Series that spans from studio to penthouse, this one-bedroom residence captures the refined sensibility of today’s modern elite. The concept centers on muted luxury - a design language that values restraint over excess, and quiet confidence over opulence. For this generation, luxury is no longer about abundance; it’s about clarity, craftsmanship, and comfort in simplicity.

With that in mind, the design strategy for this unit combines modern wood finishes with luxurious, statement materials used in thoughtful moderation. The living area features a textured wallpaper backdrop framing a custom entertainment wall, balanced by a muted, deconstructed artwork across it - creating visual depth without overwhelming the space. Walls painted in “gray-ge,” a perfect blend of gray and beige, bring warmth and neutrality, ensuring the interiors adapt beautifully to both natural and artificial light.

The furniture selections elevate everyday living - deep, wide seating wrapped in lush materials, linear accents, and modern silhouettes that exude effortless sophistication. Every element is curated to achieve comfort without compromising style.

In the bedroom, a full-height padded leather headboard anchors the space, complemented by minimalist black-framed photographs and a recessed ceiling that adds quiet dimension. Simple satin-finish walls complete the look, evoking understated elegance and refined luxury.
This one-bedroom home is a study in balance - modern yet timeless, compact yet indulgent, proving that true luxury lies in the art of subtlety.

projects.title: Luxury Penthouse
body: At the pinnacle of the Modern Luxury Series sits the penthouse - the ultimate expression of muted luxury. Designed for the modern-day elite, this space redefines sophistication by embracing the mantra that less is more. Gone are the days when opulence meant excess; today, true luxury lies in restraint, precision, and timeless elegance.

The design concept blends contemporary finishes with refined furniture and artful accessories. Every surface and texture was chosen to evoke understated grandeur - “gray-ge” walls balancing the coolness of gray and the warmth of beige, complemented by two-tone wood finishes, glossy laminates, and subtle glass details. The palette feels calm yet commanding, clean yet indulgent.

In the living and dining areas, comfort meets sophistication through deeper, wider seating, lush upholstery, and soft, tactile materials. Linear accents and modern silhouettes bring a sense of structure and quiet confidence - a reflection of the new generation’s taste for refined minimalism.

The bedroom continues this language of modern luxury. A full-height headboard anchors the space, paired with a deconstructed abstract artwork framed in brushed gold aluminum. Laser-cut bedside panels echo the same metallic tone, adding texture and light play. Subtle wall textures and a recessed ceiling complete the ambiance - a space that feels composed, layered, and effortlessly elegant.
This penthouse is more than a home - it’s a statement of contemporary luxury, defined by restraint, refinement, and a new kind of sophistication.

projects.title: Luxury Studio
body: As part of the Modern Luxury Series — spanning from studio to penthouse — this compact space embodies the essence of muted luxury for the modern-day elite. Today’s definition of sophistication has evolved. The new generation of luxury seekers gravitates toward quiet confidence — clean lines, soft palettes, and refined materials that speak volumes through simplicity.

In this studio, the challenge was to balance elegance with practicality. The design merges modern wood finishes with luxurious accent materials, creating a space that feels both indulgent and intentional. The wall behind the bed features textured wallpaper paired with a muted artwork, adding subtle depth without visual clutter. A floor-to-ceiling padded white leather headboard, flanked by beveled mirrors and highlighted by drop lighting, becomes the focal point — bringing dimension, reflection, and a soft radiance to the room.

Walls in an eggshell finish keep the look seamless and sophisticated, while a custom-built bed maximizes function and personalization for discerning residents. Accessories and décor follow a geometric rhythm — modern shapes that lend visual interest while maintaining a minimalist sensibility.

This studio proves that luxury doesn’t depend on size, but on sensibility. It’s an intimate, thoughtfully designed space where modern comfort meets understated elegance — the perfect reflection of the new elite’s refined way of living.

projects.title: Luxury Two-Bedroom
body: Part of the Modern Luxury Series - which ranges from studio units to penthouses - this two-bedroom residence embodies the quiet sophistication of today’s modern elite. Here, muted luxury takes center stage. Gone are the days when maximalist interiors defined prestige; the new generation embraces restraint, precision, and purpose. For them, luxury is about intention — clean lines, fine materials, and thoughtful comfort, especially within the constraints of modern city living.

The design strategy for this unit combines contemporary wood finishes with refined, status-symbol accents. Every detail is deliberate - walls wrapped in rich wood veneer balanced by a laser-cut panel on the opposite wall, transforming a functional surface into a subtle piece of art. The palette remains calm and cohesive, exuding a kind of elegance that whispers rather than shouts.

In the living and dining areas, modern comfort takes form through deep seating, lush fabrics, and soft, structured silhouettes. Linear accents bring in a sense of balance and refinement - a quiet nod to the aesthetic preferences of the modern-day elite.

The bedrooms carry the same design DNA. A floor-to-ceiling leather headboard anchors the space, paired with minimalist black-framed photographs for contrast and character. Simple satin-finish walls and a recessed ceiling add depth and warmth, completing the look with understated sophistication.
This two-bedroom unit reflects a lifestyle that values ease, intention, and elegance - a modern luxury that’s confident in its quietness.

projects.title: Model House Styling
body: A 200-sqm collaboration project that beautifully blends modern, Mediterranean, and Filipino design sensibilities. While the initial concept wasn’t mine, I took the reins in curation, site decision-making, and final styling—turning vision into reality.

Set within one of the newest high-end villages along Daanghari Road, this model home posed a unique challenge: capturing the attention of the South’s luxury market while working within a tight budget and an even tighter timeline. From furniture sourcing to accessory styling, every element was meticulously selected and installed in just three weeks.
The result? A model house that resonated deeply with buyers—sold just two and a half weeks after completion for ₱56 million.

A true labor of passion and precision. Every late night, every design call, every styling detail paid off—proof that great design doesn’t always start from scratch; sometimes, it’s about elevating what’s already there and making it unforgettable.

projects.title: Model Unit
body: A model unit remains one of the most powerful tools in real estate—an essential bridge between sellers and prospective buyers. Regardless of project type, market tier, or location, it offers a tangible experience that allows clients to envision their future home.

For this particular condominium project in Laguna, the focus was a 25-square-meter studio unit designed with timeless appeal. The approach was simple yet strategic: keep it clean, elegant, and universally inviting. Most walls were painted in a soft off-white, creating a bright and airy canvas, accented by subtle hints of blue and yellow for character and warmth.

Furniture selections were sourced from various suppliers—some mid-range, others high-end—proving that thoughtful curation matters more than price tags. Accessories, though modest in origin, were styled in a way that elevated the space, achieving a look that feels both refined and effortless.
The result spoke for itself. Just days after the unit’s completion, foot traffic surged, and the sales team quickly ran out of negotiation areas to accommodate the influx of interested buyers.
A clear sign of success—the design did exactly what it was meant to do.

projects.title: Scandinavian Duplex Model House
body: Set within a master-planned township in Cavite, this project was envisioned as a modern-day retreat — a place where city dwellers can slow down, breathe, and find balance. Every element, from land development to architecture and landscape, was designed to echo the essence of Scandinavian living: light, easy, and deeply relaxing.

For the duplex model house, the direction was clear - Modern Scandinavian. The goal was to create a home that feels effortless yet refined, perfectly aligned with the township’s vision. Clean walls, two-tone wood finishes, and subtle accent colors form the foundation of the design, reflecting the simplicity and warmth of the Scandinavian aesthetic.

Modern furniture pieces were carefully chosen to complement this palette - sleek yet inviting, stylish yet livable. The result is a home that feels both contemporary and comforting, where every detail works in harmony to embody the calm, uncluttered beauty of modern Scandinavian design.

projects.title: Scandinavian Single-Detached Model House
body: This single detached model house is part of a larger township project — another canvas where my team and I continued to explore that easy, breezy Scandinavian vibe paired with the clean, grounded lines of modern design.

For this one, I took a different approach. Each room was assigned to a different designer on my team. I set the direction, established the mood, and let their creativity flow. The goal was simple: to see how well our individual perspectives could align into one cohesive story.

While the duplex model carried the same aesthetic DNA, this single detached unit needed to feel more elevated — more premium. To achieve that, we added subtle hints of shine through gold metal finishes, just enough to introduce a sense of luxe without straying from the Scandinavian warmth.

Neutral tones, soft “gray-ge” walls, and two-tone wood finishes grounded the palette, while modern touches came through in the furniture: sculpted lounge chairs, stitched dining seats, and clean-lined tables and lighting. The accessories remained understated - simple shapes, soft prints, and thoughtful color blocking - to let the design breathe.
In the end, this house became proof that when different minds operate as one, the result is seamless - a unified design that feels effortless, elevated, and true to its essence.
